# AccuMold

> AccuMold is a free app for iPhone and Android that turns a phone photo into an instant mold risk report. It rates a photographed area Low, Moderate or High risk with the reasoning written out, and connects people to live video consultations with certified mold experts.

Key facts:

- The app, scans and reports are free, with no scan limit.
- Paid option: AccuPro live video consultations with a certified mold expert. 30 minutes $250, 45 minutes $375, 60 minutes $500, one flat price paid up front.
- Risk levels: Low means keep an eye on it. Moderate means dry it out and scan again in 48 hours. High means get it looked at by a professional.
- A report is a risk assessment based on the photo and the user's answers, not a laboratory result. AccuMold does not test for airborne mold.
- Founder and inventor: Josh Kent, with 20+ years in mold, moisture and water damage.
- Credentials shown on the site: Indoor Air Quality Association (IAQA) certification and Better Business Bureau (BBB) accreditation.
- Download: [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/accumold-ai-mold-detector/id6756345105), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.accumold.ai)
